items.text: Kolot Samuson Gasa, koany kaŋ ina naadote, koloma mamakeŋ.
Kolimokinai Igasan ebe, “Abu Samuson ne.” Kolukutu ŋes, koperut ŋes akuare kere korute lokore, kililinata akuare kere, kobalas ebe, “Kiwala akwap, kiari ŋes.”
Koper Samuson kiton kidinebai, konyou kidiŋebai, kitin ikirigin luka erute lokore, ka ategerio aarei, kouto kes, ka atiket da, korioŋak kes okeperinike, kodaka kes aidi naka eronat loitei Keburon.
Kosodi kanen akaulo kanun, abu ŋesi kominak aberu kaditot naka Sorek, ekekiror Delila.

Kopotu ijaka luka Ipilisitian neejai nin, kotemasi ŋes atiar, “Kiiodiiod ŋes, kojen neelomunitor akegogoŋ naepol, ka epone lokipedoria aipikor ŋes, tetere kipedori ajen ŋes aitiean ŋes: kiinakini isio jo ninidiopet kasio atutubeta akwat atomon kanadiopet luka epuesa.”
Kotema Delila Samuson atiar, “Kenainait, kolimokinai neelomunitor akonigogoŋ naepol, ka epone lokienere jo aitican.”
Kotema Samuson ŋes atiar, “Arai kaenata kesi eoŋ kigegoi ikanykaarei luepalal lumam itoonitoi, ŋes kito akalanyanaror eoŋ, kiputokin kalucetuna.”
Kosodete ijaka luka Ipilisitian ainun ŋin igegoi ikanykaarei luepalal lumam itoonitoi, koenia nin ŋes,
Ajaas nin ikaperunok ago la nakotoma. Kotema nin ŋes atiar, “Samuson, kibunokis jo Ipilisitian.” Koned igegoi kwape enedar eusi loka amujajut ketiro akim. Kwaŋin mam akegogoŋ ajenio.
Kotema Delila Samuson atiar, “Koany, kimod ijo eoŋ, kilimokinit da nuka aisab: asa keŋainait, kolimokinai epone lokienere jo.”
Kotema ŋes atiar, “Arai kaenata kesieon kaunoi nukitetiak numam itwasamatai adioswam, ŋes kito akalanyanaror eoŋ, kiputokin kalucetuna.”
Kolem Delila aunoi nukitetiak, koenia ŋes, kotema atiar, “Samuson, kibunokis jo Ipilisitian.” Kibojete ikaperunok kagola nakotoma. Koŋeda kes kakaninike bala eusi.

Kotema Delila Samuson atiar, “Okwe, kimod ijo eoŋ kiton kwana, kilimokinit da nuka aisab: kolimokinai epone lokienere jo.” Kotema ŋes atiar, “Arai kicipak ijo ikatim luieipitai irwan akanykaarei oboro luicipi.”
Abu nin kiketak nul keloit, kotema ŋes atiar, “Samuson, kibunokis jo Ipilisitian.” Kokweny kotoma ajo, kout eloit ka aieipet da.
Kotema nin ŋes atiar, “Itemari ijo biai ebe, ‘Kamina jo,’ komam lekonitau ejaas keoŋ? Kimod eoŋ irwan nu auni, mam da kilimokinit eoŋ neelomunitor akonigogoŋ naepol.”
Kosodi kanen kieebok ŋin abokobok ŋes kaimaima ninlpaaran kakiroke, abu eketau kokadak kiton atwanare.

Abu kolimok ŋes nukotauke kere, kotema ŋes atiar, “Mam ejutet icakit akouka; naarai arai eoŋ Enasirit loka Edeke ageun kakoik naka totoka: arai kebareni akakou ŋes kito enyounio akagogoŋ kamakaŋ, akalanyanar, kiputokin da kalucetuŋa.”

Kejenu Delila ebe alimoki ŋes nukotauke kere, abu kijuka anyaraun iiaka luka Ipilisitian ebe, “Kopotu do irwan na bon, naarai kalimok eoŋ nukotauke kere.” Kosodete ijaka luka Ipilisitian aponare mamake koyaunito apesan kakanikec.
Abu kitoioto ŋes kakejeke; kosodi nin anyaraun etuŋanan kobareno iketim lueeipitai irwan akanykaarei; kogeu aitican ŋes, konyou akegogoŋ kamake,
Kotema atiar, “Samuson, kibunokis jo Ipilisitian.” Kokweny kotoma ajo, kobala ebe, “Alomari kwape lem sek, kasodi ailakilakaar.” Konye mam ajeni ebe abu EJAKAIT konyou kamaken.
Kikamut Ipilisitian ŋes, kogorut akekonye; koyanaasi ŋes Gasa, koenata kirikoi luka aisinit; abu kirienenei kaidaris.
Konye apotu iketim kogeut apol bobo kedaun abaren ŋes,
Kosodete kotukonokinos iiaka luka Ipilisitian ainakin Dagon ekecedeke asubanit naepol, kalakara da: naarai abalas ebe, “Kijaik edekewok oni Samuson lokasurupiwok akaniniwok.”
Keanyut ituŋa ŋes, apotu kituroto edekekee: naarai abalas ebe, “Kiiaik edekewok oni lokasurupiwok akaniniwok, loemudiarit awokokwap, loaar luipu kaoni.”
Kosodi kanen, kiyalamikinos ikecetauon, apotu kotemasi ebe, “Konyarautu Samuson, koboliak oni,” Konyaraut Samuson kaidaris; koboliak kes: kibwaikis ŋes kidin opirin,
Kotema Samuson esapat loarikit ŋes kakan ebe, “Kocamakinai kararapa ipirin luiganito etogo, tetere agonakini kes.”
Eleleba etogo ikiliok ka aŋor; iiaka kere luka Ipilisitian ajaas nen; ajaas ikiliok ka aŋor kwape ilukumin iuni kuiu togo, lueteete Samuson eboliakini kes.
Kiworo Samuson EJAKAIT, kobala ebe, “Wu EJAKAIT Edeke, kenainait kiitunoi, kenaiŋait kitogogonoi, irwan na bon, wu Edeke, tetere enyanari atipet akakonye aarei kaneejaas Ipilisitian.”
Kitin Samuson ipirin iarei lukokidin lueganito etogo, kogonakin kes, ediopet kakekan nakoteten, ediopet da kakekan nakokediany.

Kotema Samuson atiar, “Mere katwana nepepe k Ipilisitian.” Kokukum kakegogon kere; kotiyaikin etogo ijaka, ka ituŋa kere luajaas toma. Kwaŋin lukatwak luaari ŋesi kapak naka atwanareke epu adepar luaari ŋesi eiari,
Kosodete ikeinaean ka ekal kere loka papake aponare, kolemutu ŋes, koyanaut, kidaikis ŋes kidin kaSora ka Esitaol aibois nakidaanakina naka Manoa papake, Abu ŋesi kotubok Isirael ikar akaisaarei.
